claim: DragPoint moves a wall's point and follows nextwall round to every wall that shares that point, so a sliding or rotating sector whose edges coincide with its host's drags the host's walls with it.
evidence: projects/blood-city/level/curtains.py: a curtain fin carved as the auditorium's own hole moved the auditorium; DOOR-CURTAINS s3 cuts the slot as a notch of one-sided walls instead
use: Stand a mover in a hole of its host with only the edges meant to be portals shared; check the whole swept travel, as the build's swept-state gate does.
